question: The glomerular filtration rate increases when:

options.opa: Increases the resistance in the glomerular afferent arteriole.
options.opb: Decreases the resistance in the glomerular efferent arteriole.
options.opc: Increases the activity of the renal sympathetic nerves.
options.opd: Obstruction of the urinary tract occurs.
options.ope: Decreases the concentration of plasma proteins.
